qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the glow plug (1AZ)?
What torque value should I use for the 4" glow plug (2AZ)?
Which components use M21/M41/M51 screw types?
qa_pairs.answer: The 4" glow plug (2AZ) and wire to glow plug (3AZ) both use M21/M41/M51 screw types.

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between the standard glow plug and the 4" glow plug?
qa_pairs.answer: The standard glow plug requires 25 Nm while the 4" glow plug requires 20 Nm, a difference of 5 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection covers glow plug specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 12-6 Engine Electrical Equipment, subsection 12.23 Glow Plugs

qa_pairs.question: Which glow plug component has the lowest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The wire to glow plug (3AZ) has the lowest torque specification at 4 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What units are used for all the torque specifications in this table?
qa_pairs.answer: All torque specifications are given in Nm (Newton-meters).

qa_pairs.question: How many different glow plug related components are listed in this specification table?
qa_pairs.answer: Three components are listed: glow plug (1AZ), glow plug 4" (2AZ), and wire to glow plug (3AZ).
